Proof. Proof of Archimedean realisation of jet prolongation

Apply jet prolongation to the categorical data (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) underlying the archimedean quantum observable universe (\mathbb{C}-quantum observable universe) with substrate parameter q. Here, \mathbf{C} = \mathrm{Rep}(\mathrm{SU}_{q}(2)), A = \mathcal{O}_q(\mathrm{SU}(2)), and \tau is the forgetful functor. The fibre functor \tau translates the categorical jet object J^1(A) into the geometric first jet bundle J^1 \mathcal{S}, the inherited Frobenius–Hopf structure into the connection A', and the non-degeneracy and vanishing conditions into the analytic criteria of a \mathbb{C}-quantum observable universe.
